description: This bar chart, titled "Self-Interpretability LLMs Can Describe Complex Internal Processes that Drive Their Decisions, and Improve with Training," illustrates the "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" for two LLM models, "GPT-4o" and "GPT-4o-mini," across three conditions: "Control," "Before Introspection Training," and "After Introspection Training." The vertical axis, labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)," ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.25. The horizontal axis displays the two model categories. For each model, three bars are grouped side-by-side: the "Control" condition is represented by a gray bar, "Before Introspection Training" by a teal bar, and "After Introspection Training" by a dark purple bar. Error bars are present above each bar, indicating variability. For the GPT-4o model, the Control bar is at approximately 0.15, the Before Training bar is at approximately 0.55, and the After Training bar is at approximately 0.75. For the GPT-4o-mini model, the Control bar is near zero (approximately 0.01), the Before Training bar is at approximately 0.50, and the After Training bar is at approximately 0.75. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the legend: Control, Before, After. The "After Introspection Training" bars for both models are the tallest, visually demonstrating the highest accuracy.
